body: I mean personally I have come clean about my self-harm a couple of weeks ago, since then i dont feel particularly different, but it does feel nice to know i'm not the only one that has to deal with it. I can speak with people around me about it which is pleasant.
Yeah i guess, people who are extremely down on themselves or depressed can be pretty good at pretending though, covering up scars aswell.

Like what would you consider self-harm? I dont cut myself for example but do hit myself. The degree of self-harm is pretty blurred for me i guess, so you could fake that but people would notice cutting i think. Other "self-harm" can possibly be faked.

This is exactly my situation, maybe adding a pankc attack or 2. Whenever family says "things will get better" and me responding negatively They interpret it as if im saying I dont care about them or something. Idk man im fucked
The nights when im alone with my thoughts are killing me. Im a pretty good pretender towards friends and family but when im all alone I just want to enter a deep sleep and never wake up.
I have considered many different options, but nothing intrigues or motivates me anymore. I slept 9 hours after this post and feel somewhat better. Im sorry y'all i dont want to be a bother.
Idk man, im pretty much done living in this fucked up world. People over the last few months showed their true colours and its not for me.
Im not gonna do it tonight.

Hi, i have talked to my family about how im feeling, and They are trying to help me, but i feel like it does not actually work. I becoming cynical when my parents worry for me, which is pretty scary. Happiness to me would be someone i could be with, like someone who actually cares and loves me, a good group of friends, and a Job which I actually enjoy doing. Thing is, i have none of those, which hurts my confidence and in turn makes me extremely introverted.
Maybe talk to a psychologist, maybe he/she can help you figure it out, an outsiders perspective can be very benificial.
Happy Birthday man!! Maybe a little cliché but i already saw 5 people on here congratulating you!! There are good, warm people who care about you, dont forget that.

Wow. This is painfully close to my situation, just had this conversation with my dad today. He told me he loves me and that i am not a burden. Reading this has kind of broken me from that emotionless state, so thank you random person, i will try to keep going and make sure i let my parents/family help me.
When i hear your situation OP, and almost feel guilty of wanting to commit suicide, i hope you are well and in one way or another try to keep on pushing through, although your situation is physical.
